package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"testing"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// scenario for shared_integration_test_setup_not_centralized_under_test_support: Repeated app, DB, or router bootstrapping that is not moved into shared test support.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func TestGetUserIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "host=localhost dbname=test sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to open db: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	if _, err := db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)`); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to migrate: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := db.Exec(`INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ($1)`, "alice"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to seed: %v", err)
	}

	var name string
	if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1`, 1).Scan(&name); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to query: %v", err)
	}
	if name != "alice" {
		t.Fatalf("expected alice, got %s", name)
	}
}
